64-8043-8350.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
64-8043-8350.description:
Cast Face Yourself for free due to Vision, targeting yourself and creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste and the noted exile clause.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Warden of the Eye token enters, it triggers, returning Face Yourself from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2317-3967-6763-7084.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending Dwarven Mine.
Resolve the Yahenni ability, giving Yahenni indestructible until end of turn
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Dwarven Mine.
When Dwarven Mine dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning Dwarven Mine from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer
When Dwarven Mine enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Dwarf creature token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability, giving Yahenni indestructible until end of turn
Repeat.

678-3899-5865.notablePrerequisites: An opponent has lost life this turn
678-3899-5865.description:
Cast Flamecache Gecko by paying its mana cost.
When Flamecache Gecko enters, it triggers, adding {B}{R}.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Flamecache Gecko.
When Flamecache Gecko dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Flamecache Gecko from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

5170-6132-7574-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Sultai Flayer triggers, causing you to gain 4 life
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Sultai Flayer trigger.
Resolve the Sultai Flayer trigger, causing you to gain 4 life
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

144-728-5434.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2 greater than the largest life total among your opponents.
144-728-5434.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Ashcloud Phoenix.
When Ashcloud Phoenix dies, its first ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Ashcloud Phoenix.
Yarus' second ability triggers, returning Ashcloud Phoenix from your graveyard to the battlefield face down, and then turning it face up.
Ashcloud Phoenix's second ability triggers, dealing 2 damage to each player.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability
Repeat.

222-527-4885-8095.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-4885-8095.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Hammerhead twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

1170-1477-1976-5131--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-1477-1976-5131--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Etherium Sculptor.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature
Repeat.

851-1308-4365-5478-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Spelunking.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat
851-1308-4365-5478-7942.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

4364-5256-7917.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
4364-5256-7917.description:
Declare Aurelia and Seluma as attackers. Aurelia triggers, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Aurelia.
Deal combat damage using Seluma. Seluma triggers, returning Aurelia from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1563-2457-7060-7824.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

2301-2946-4871-6797.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2301-2946-4871-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Abzan Ascendancy trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

997-5086-6972.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Triskelavus.
When Triskelavus dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

3259-4478-7603.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to another creature you control that has base power 0 that doesn't have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4478-7603.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached, triggering Breath of Fury and Primo.
Resolve the Primo trigger, creating a 0/0 Fractal creature token that enters with a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to the damage dealt.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to and attach it to the Fractal token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

933-4377-5531.easyPrerequisites: You control at least three Islands.
933-4377-5531.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons for its buyback cost by paying {4}{U}{U} and sacrificing three Islands, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and return Walk the Aeons to your hand.
Blink Lumra using Conjurer's Closet.
When Lumra enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards and then return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat each turn.

2604-3532-4928-5078.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
2604-3532-4928-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Forgotten Ancient triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

5170-5256-6132-6794.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Susurian Voidborn triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Susurian Voidborn trigger.
Resolve the Susurian Voidborn trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-3000-3899-4552-5089.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Karn, the Great Creator.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

3384-4067-7064.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
3384-4067-7064.description:
Activate Professor Zei's first ability by tapping it and discarding a card, causing you to draw two cards due to Thought Reflection.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Professor Zei.
Repeat.

2876-4050-7049.notablePrerequisites: The number of creatures you control is equal to or greater than 5 plus Elenda's commander tax.
2876-4050-7049.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Elenda, adding {W}.
Choose to return Elenda from your graveyard to the command zone.
When Elenda dies, it triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Vampire creature tokens equal to its power.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Vampire, adding {B}.
Repeat step 4 until you have enough mana to cast Elenda.
Cast Elenda from the command zone by paying {2}{W}{B} plus commander tax, if applicable.
Repeat.

4968-6774-6919.description:
Cast Strength of Will by paying {1}{G}, targeting Deathbringer Thoctar.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to it.
Deathbringer Thoctar triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Loading Zone.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 2.
4968-6774-6919.notes: You can skip step 4 if desired.

856-1379-6748-6757-6798.description:
Cast Cauldron Familiar by paying {B}.
When Cauldron Familiar enters, it and Weapons Manufacturing trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Weapons Manufacturing trigger, creating a Munitions artifact token.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing the Munitions, as it is a Food due to Ragost.
The Munitions triggers, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2428-2541-2919.description:
Activate Benthic Biomancer by paying {1}{U}, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Benthic Biomancer triggers, causing you to loot.
Horizon Chimera triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Repeat from step 2.

4659-5365-5494-6627.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional artifact
4659-5365-5494-6627.description:
Activate Lonis by paying {2} and sacrificing another artifact.
If the artifact was a Clue, Lonis' third ability triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on any other creature you control.
Resolve the Lonis ability, putting two +1/+1 counters on it and causing you to draw a card.
Lonis' second ability triggers, creating two Clue artifact tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Clue, adding {C}{C}.
Lonis' third ability triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on any other creature you control.
Repeat.

465-1322-3742-4251-5929.notablePrerequisites: Leyline of Transformation on the battlefield with "Samurai" chosen.
465-1322-3742-4251-5929.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

224-4481-6133.notablePrerequisites:
Avenging Druid does not have summoning sickness.
Heavy Arbalest attached to Avenging Druid.
224-4481-6133.description:
Activate Avenging Druid by tapping it, dealing 2 damage to an opponent.
Avenging Druid triggers, causing you to reveal a land card from your library and put it onto the battlefield, and put all other cards revealed this way into your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Avenging Druid.
Repeat until no lands remain in your library and/or your library is empty.

1479-2907-5478-5700-5701.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-2907-5478-5700-5701.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and each Scute Swarm you control trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve a Scute Swarm trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, each Scute Swarm you control triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve a Scute Swarm trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, each Scute Swarm you control triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

1733-2792-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Nephalia Smuggler.
Nephalia Smuggler does not have summoning sickness.
You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{U}.
1733-2792-4222.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{U}.
Activate Nephalia Smuggler by paying {3}{U} and tapping it, blinking Great Whale.
When Great Whale enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Nephalia Smuggler.
Repeat.
If you control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana.

198-236-4019.notablePrerequisites: Empowered Autogenerator does not have summoning sickness and has at least two charge counters on it.
198-236-4019.description:
Activate Empowered Autogenerator by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding at least {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Bring to Life by paying {2}{U}, causing Empowered Autogenerator to become a 0/0 artifact creature and putting four +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Vigean Graftmage by paying {1}{U}, untapping Empowered Autogenerator.
Activate Empowered Autogenerator by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Repeat from step 3.

2034-2308-2606-3000-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Pelakka Wurm, adding {C}{C}.
When Pelakka Wurm dies, its second ability and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Pelakka Wurm trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger from step 2, causing you to pay {4} to return Pelakka Wurm from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Pelakka Wurm enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, causing you to gain 7 life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the Fungus Beast and Squirrel, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

1339-2425-5231.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1339-2425-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Smothering Abomination triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Repeat.

1981-1984-2584.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
1981-1984-2584.description:
Cast Angel's Grace by paying {W}.
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
Pandemonium triggers, dealing damage to you equal to the creature's power, with your life total becoming no lower than 1 due to Angel's Grace.
Darien triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Soldier creature tokens equal to the damage dealt to you.
When the Soldiers enter the battlefield, Pandemonium triggers that many times.
Resolve the first trigger, dealing 1 damage to you, with your life total becoming no lower than 1 due to Angel's Grace.
Repeat from step 3.

2034-3426-3719-4871.description:
Cast Deranged Hermit by paying {3}{G}{G}.
Deranged Hermit enters the battlefield, creating four 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Deranged Hermit and a Squirrel token, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Ruthless Technomancer by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing a Treasure token, returning Deranged Hermit from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

174-570-2178-4050.notablePrerequisites:
You control a blue and a black permanent.
Thornbite Staff attached to Faeburrow Elder.
Faeburrow Elder does not have summoning sickness.
174-570-2178-4050.description:
Activate Faeburrow Elder by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Worldheart Phoenix, adding one mana of any color.
Worldheart Phoenix dies, triggering Faeburrow Elder, untapping Faeburrow Elder.
Cast Worldheart Phoenix from your graveyard by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Repeat.
